title: When the Prom Sings
author: Noor Marchetti
blurb: Jude Whitlock, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
